# Literal positive row sums for the E-up, F-down table

This is the certificate appendix to [the one-terminal exclusion](CB882_E_UP_F_ABOVE_B.md), using the [literal row appendix](CB882_E_UP_F_DOWN_ROWS.md). All weights are positive integers. In a context C, `Rnnnn:w` means w times C.Rnnnn. Different deduction lines use the same original context box and rows; none uses a preceding deduction in that context.

A bound line `(k,s,b)` asserts s z_k<=s b. Its nonnegative reserve is `10^6 s b-(B-L)`, with a, B, L defined in the cover chapter. The displayed reserve lower bounds are rational numbers; checking them requires only the displayed row coefficients, weights and box endpoints. A terminal line has reserve L-B>0.
